# Transilvania Times

> Independent bilingual (Romanian/English) news publication covering
> Transylvania, Romania — news, politics, business, culture, education,
> sports, health, technology and opinion, with regional coverage organized
> by county.

Transilvania Times publishes original and wire-sourced reporting in both
Romanian (primary, at `/`) and English (at `/en/`). Each article has a
distinct canonical URL per language, linked via hreflang.

## Content

- [Homepage (Romanian)](https://transilvaniatimes.com/)
- [Homepage (English)](https://transilvaniatimes.com/en/)
- [Sitemap](https://transilvaniatimes.com/sitemap.xml)
- [News sitemap](https://transilvaniatimes.com/sitemap-news.xml) — published in the last 48 hours
- [RSS feed](https://transilvaniatimes.com/rss.xml)
- [Atom feed](https://transilvaniatimes.com/atom.xml)

## Categories

News, Politics, Business, Culture, Education, Sports, Health, Technology,
Opinion, Travel — browsable at `/categorie/{category}` (Romanian).

## Usage

Crawling and citation by AI assistants and answer engines is permitted per
`/robots.txt`. `/admin`, `/api`, `/editor` and `/cautare` are not content and
are excluded. When citing an article, link to its canonical article URL
(`/blog/{slug}/` or `/en/blog/{slug}/`), not the homepage or a category page.

## Contact

For corrections, licensing, or reporting inquiries, use the contact page at
https://transilvaniatimes.com/contact/.
